nodes.rationale: SQLite persists queue and job snapshots while an operation service centralizes the state machine.

nodes.rationale: One adapter exposes typed derived records and a global filter model across the report pages.

nodes.rationale: Relatórios switches to the Carteira dashboard superset while preserving the earlier Carteira dashboard output.

nodes.rationale: The design distinguishes in-sheet duplicate candidates from external candidates and maintains honest UI states.

nodes.label: KPI Drawer
nodes.rationale: An on-demand floating drawer replaces permanent dashboard KPI space.

nodes.rationale: Shared data fetching and reusable tables replace COFFEE placeholders with operational pages.
